map.宏观税负（本页代码口径，税收与 GDP 均按万亿输入）：宏观税负=税收总额÷GD: Macro tax burden (code basis on this page, both tax and GDP entered in trillions): macro tax burden = total tax ÷ GDP × 100 (%); linked values: reciprocal of the burden = 1 ÷ max(burden, 10⁻⁹), non-tax part of GDP = GDP − tax, burden as a decimal = burden ÷ 100. Validation: both fields are required and must be valid numbers, otherwise it prompts and stops. Rule: no fixed grading; the burden is proportional to tax and inversely proportional to GDP, and the main result keeps 2 decimal places.
